name: Ananias
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Saul himself is given a vision of Ananias coming to restore his sight. People are still given dreams and visions this way, some seeing a man show them truth before they understood it was about Israel.

Ananias objects: he has heard by many how much evil this man has done to the saints at Jerusalem, and that he holds authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on the Most High's name. Saul had consented to Stephen's death and chased disciples from city to city with zeal.

Ananias enters, lays his hands on him as "Brother Saul," and immediately something like scales fall from his eyes, he receives sight, and is baptized. Paul was not taught by Peter or the other apostles; Christ himself taught him directly.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
